We are taking a pause because we have 33 bins accumulated. The accumulation started while we were experiencing issues with M4. The M4 alarm was activated, the machine was not running properly, product was accumulating, and the sensor was rejecting frequently. While the M4 issue was being resolved, the bins continued to accumulate. Maintenance made the necessary adjustments, and M4 is now running properly. We then started having issues with the Cute Cavanna. The cut sensor was not detecting properly, causing the machine to stop on its own. We are also still experiencing the issue from yesterday where the flow wrap is getting cut and small strips are coming off. Maintenance is continuing to work on the Cute Cavanna.
The Cute Cavanna is good to go I found a loose lock nut on the fin wheel and I installed a magnetic holder for the hatch.

During the Kitchen pause, Javier noticed that the Water Cooling Stage was set to 11 instead of 13, as indicated on the One Point Lesson posted next to the screen. The value was found to be saved at 11 in the recipe, which caused the piping to freeze during the pause. The setting was adjusted, and a short reheat is being completed to thaw the piping. Javier will update the recipe to 13 and save the change. An action will also be added to the startup checklist to verify the Water Cooling Stage temperature during startup.

Hi Team,

Erandy and I observed that the caramel hopper level sensor was fluctuating significantly and was showing an inaccurate level reading.

Based on Erandy’s previous experience with the same issue at Lindon 3, where sunlight affected the sensor, we placed cardboard around the sensor to block the sunlight.

After doing this, the level reading improved by approximately 95% and remained stable without significant fluctuations.
